phases.name: 2026 Toyota AFL Finals Series
phases.summary: The expanded 2026 Toyota AFL Finals Series opens with Wildcard Finals before the top-eight premiership race concludes at the MCG.
details: Wildcard Finals open the series: seventh plays 10th and eighth plays ninth, while the top six receive a bye into the first full week of finals.
The AFL will publish clubs, venues and kick-off times as the ladder and final-series pathway resolve.
The Grand Final is confirmed for Saturday 26 September at 2.30pm AEST at the MCG.
No exact public seller endpoint is published in this catalogue, so the card does not display a ticket CTA.

editorialNarrative.hook: The first wildcard weekend has turned Carlton's 1–8 recovery and Arty Jones' breakout into two sudden-death paths through September.
editorialNarrative.synopsis: Carlton and the Western Bulldogs survived the AFL's inaugural wildcard weekend in very different ways: the Blues extended a recovery from a 1–8 start, while first-final player Arty Jones kicked four goals in a three-point Bulldogs win. They now meet Geelong and Adelaide respectively as the top-six clubs enter the race to the MCG.

fixtures.name: Wildcard Final - Melbourne v Carlton
fixtures.summary: Official AFL schedule: Melbourne v Carlton at MCG.

editorialNarrative.hook: Carlton's recovery from a one-and-eight start met Melbourne's surprise finals season; the advancing side remains concealed here.
editorialNarrative.synopsis: Melbourne's first season under Steven King rose from low expectations into finals contention. Carlton entered the same knockout after Josh Fraser inherited one positive result from nine matches and drove a late charge, making the wildcard a collision between an early-season rise and a late-season rescue.
editorialNarrative.hookSpoilerOn: Carlton defeated Melbourne 74-55. Carlton's recovery from a one-and-eight start met Melbourne's surprise finals season.
editorialNarrative.synopsisSpoilerOn: Carlton defeated Melbourne 74-55. Melbourne v Carlton finished 55-74 in Wildcard Finals, with Carlton winning by 19 points. The result now advances or resolves the same 2026 AFL thread described in the spoiler-safe preview.

fixtures.name: Wildcard Final - Western Bulldogs v Collingwood
fixtures.summary: Official AFL schedule: Western Bulldogs v Collingwood at MCG.

editorialNarrative.hook: The first AFL wildcard final came down to one kick after the siren; the survivor is hidden until spoilers are enabled.
editorialNarrative.synopsis: Western Bulldogs brought an eight-wins-in-11 recovery into the first wildcard final, while Collingwood's pressure game had rediscovered features of its premiership identity. The new Final Ten compressed both arcs into one elimination night, ultimately separated by a shot after the siren.

fixtures.name: Qualifying & Elimination Final - Fremantle v Hawthorn
fixtures.summary: Official AFL schedule: Fremantle v Hawthorn at Optus Stadium.

editorialNarrative.hook: Minor premier Fremantle meets the Hawthorn side that seized fourth on the final day; the reward is a week off, not elimination.
editorialNarrative.synopsis: Fremantle's 19-win season earned the first qualifying final at Optus Stadium. Hawthorn arrived after its final-round performance delivered the last top-four place, so this became a contest between season-long control and a late seeding surge, with a direct home preliminary-final place at stake.

fixtures.name: Qualifying & Elimination Final - Sydney Swans v Brisbane Lions
fixtures.summary: Official AFL schedule: Sydney Swans v Brisbane Lions at SCG.

editorialNarrative.hook: Sydney's five straight wins meet Brisbane's three in a qualifying final that turns current form into a week-off prize.
editorialNarrative.synopsis: Sydney finished second after five consecutive wins; Brisbane closed third with three of its own. The SCG qualifying final therefore matches the two strongest finishing streaks on this side of the bracket, with the winner bypassing the semi-finals and the loser retaining one life.

fixtures.name: Qualifying & Elimination Final - Geelong Cats v Carlton
fixtures.summary: Official AFL schedule: Geelong Cats v Carlton at MCG.

editorialNarrative.hook: Carlton's rescue from a one-win, eight-loss start has one life left against a Geelong side that closed the season with six straight wins.
editorialNarrative.synopsis: Carlton carried its comeback through the wildcard round and now meets the form team of the run-in. Geelong's six-match winning finish secured fifth and an MCG elimination final; the contrast is a long recovery against late-season continuity, with no second chance for either.

editorialNarrative.hook: The Bulldogs survived the first wildcard by one kick; Adelaide now asks them to win sudden-death football away from home.
editorialNarrative.synopsis: Western Bulldogs reached Adelaide only after the inaugural wildcard was decided by an after-the-siren miss. The Crows earned sixth and the home elimination final, turning this into a test of whether wildcard momentum travels against a side whose whole season secured this venue advantage.

editorialNarrative.hook: The finalists are locked, but an unsettled top four means eight known teams still do not know the shape of their September road.
editorialNarrative.synopsis: Penrith has secured a top-two finish, but the rest of the order remains live. South Sydney is back in the finals for the first time since 2022, the Dolphins are there for the first time, and Brisbane's absence guarantees a new champion. The series ends at Accor Stadium on 4 October, with seeding still to decide how each club can get there.
